title: Monitoring Station
description: Find the asteroid with the best line of sight, then simulate a rotating laser vaporizing asteroids.
writeup:
## Approach

Line-of-sight is determined by angle: two asteroids at the same angle from a station block each other. Normalize directions using GCD to group collinear asteroids.

## Part 1

For each asteroid, count unique directions to all others. The direction `(dx, dy)` is normalized by dividing by `gcd(|dx|, |dy|)`, so collinear asteroids share the same key. The asteroid with the most unique directions wins.

## Part 2

Simulate the rotating laser:
1. Group all asteroids by their normalized direction from the station.
2. Within each group, sort by Manhattan distance (closest first).
3. Sort the direction groups by clockwise angle from straight up, using `atan2(dx, -dy)`.
4. Sweep repeatedly: in each pass, vaporize the closest remaining asteroid in each direction. The 200th vaporized gives the answer.
